measure.candidate_sql:
SELECT t.post_id FROM phasec_seo_tidy_link_terms t
                INNER JOIN phasec_posts p ON p.ID=t.post_id
                WHERE t.term IN ('garden','planning','uncategorized') AND t.post_id <> 50
                  AND p.post_type IN ('post','page') AND p.post_status='publish'
                GROUP BY t.post_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, t.post_id ASC LIMIT 30

execution_notes: Contracts executed once; HTTP executed once after a Windows UTF-8 reader setup error before requests.
Each measured corpus indexed once: 8 batches at 200; grew to 1000 then 40 batches.
After measurement, 975 synthetic posts moved to draft while preserving Smart Topics, leaving 25 for races.

Paired scans executed once. Edit stage initially skipped because persisted index remained complete; a subsequent overlong worker name was rejected before scan start. Only the edit probe was resumed with explicit preflight save and a valid name.
Edit probe exits 1 for the observed freshness violation. The completed benchmark and contract results do not imply concurrency acceptance.

Full-corpus integration pair negatives may be affected by caps. The earlier standalone suite also checks isolated pairs; direct integration eligibility/zero-posting assertions are independent of ranking.

Scan durations exclude WordPress bootstrap but include administrator/nonce setup. Memory peak includes bootstrap. Ten source measurements are single samples with mixed request-local cache warmth; p95 of ten uses nearest rank and equals maximum.
Core update checks produced expected external-HTTP-blocked warnings. No plugin PHP fatal was observed in the completed contract/benchmark runs.
